title: Box stack at rest
objective: Box stack at rest: stays still, contact forces balance gravity, penetration bounded

primary_metric.name: floor contact force relative error
primary_metric.definition: |F_floor - g sum(m)| / (g sum(m)); plus top box stillness and penetration

model_assumptions: three 10 cm boxes stacked on a plane with MuJoCo's default soft contact; force = summed normal force between the floor and the bottom box at the end; stillness measured after a 1 s settle.

variants.task: Boxes of 2, 1 and 0.5 kg from the bottom.
Boxes of 0.5, 1 and 2 kg from the bottom.
Negative control: gravity off (contact forces vanish).

grading: referee/criteria.json via oracle.py (stdlib only, run in a separate isolated interpreter)
